title: Two Oh Four: Empty. Two Oh Five: A Bus Tour.

cover.label: and a bus tour walks in
cover.headline: 2:04 empty. 2:05 *bus tour.*

scenes.say: Two oh four, the cafe is empty. Two oh five, a bus tour walks in.
Three tables, three orders, all at once. Dev has not even put his coffee down.

scenes.speaker: Ivan
scenes.say: And the first guest in line has one question. Do you have a restroom?
Then it is the usual. Separate checks. The oat milk running out. And you, smiling through all of it.
Tag the owner who has lived this. Follow for more cafe life.
